name: md-cross-border
description: Moldova 2026 cross-border income tax for resident companies and individuals, nonresident recipients, withholding payers and permanent establishments. Explains residence and population-specific foreign income, Moldova-source service and property categories, ordinary and historic dividend withholding, PE profit attribution, treaty evidence and refunds, foreign tax credit limits, arrival basis and departure property rules. Includes approved monthly nonresident reporting fields, statutory deadlines and two recomputing examples. Use for foreign supplier payments, royalties, interest, dividends, overseas income, construction projects, nonresident property and individual relocation. Current forms, treaty-specific applications and identified implementation gaps remain explicit; the bounded source-review record is linked under Sources.
